messages:
Annie (PM): quick idea: when someone saves a per-route or multi-route view, provide a small, exportable "estimate pack" that shows expected token burn, p50 latency, and an uncertainty band per model variant. helps ops pick defaults and justify quota requests.
Keiko (Eng): love the exportable piece. Implementation note: we should cap to top N variants (by traffic) and include a fidelity score. otherwise estimates explode for tail models.
Raj (Console): UI thought: show a collapsed banner "Cost & Performance estimates (click to expand)" with a button to download CSV. CSV includes columns: model, variant, est_tokens_per_request, est_latency_ms, est_cost_usd, confidence_pct.
Nina (SRE): privacy check: do NOT include raw prompts or traces in the CSV. only aggregated estimates. Also ensure any sampling used is recorded (sample_rate, window).
Keiko (Eng): backend contract proposal: new endpoint POST /v1/estimates/saved_view -> accepts {filters, routes:[], max_variants:5, include_confidence:true, sample_hint:0.02}. returns small JSON array. We should keep request idempotent.
Annie (PM): can we include a simple example response shape for the Console folks?
Keiko (Eng): ```json
[ {"model":"redwood-alpha","variant":"q4_0","est_tokens":120.5,"est_latency_ms":230,"est_cost_usd":0.0048,"confidence_pct":86}, {"model":"open-7b","variant":"fp16","est_tokens":95.2,"est_latency_ms":340,"est_cost_usd":0.0036,"confidence_pct":72} ]
```
Raj (Console): perfect. front-end will show confidence as a small progress ring and color-code (green/yellow/red). We'll hide variants with confidence < 50% by default and show an "include low-confidence" toggle.
Keiko (Eng): sampling approach: use reservoir sampling on recent window (last 24h) with default sample_hint=0.01. If org requests an estimate we temporarily increase sampling for that org for a short backfill (e.g., 30m) to improve stability. Afterwards we aggregate and evict raw samples.
Nina (SRE): agree but limit bump to avoid overload. Also require org-level quota tokens for on-demand sample boosts. We should meter these and show consumption in billing+.
Annie (PM): rollout suggestion: feature flag gated + opt-in in org settings. Start with internal teams, then 5% of customers, track two metrics: estimate-MAE (mean absolute error) between estimate and actual 24h post-save, and preview-usage (% of saves that view the estimate).
Keiko (Eng): MAE tracking needs aligning: compute MAE per model variant aggregated across requests matching the saved filters. Will need a join between saved view fingerprint and routing logs.
Raj (Console): UX edge-case: multi-route saved views that aggregate across routes. show a per-route breakdown and an aggregated row. CSV should include route column.
Nina (SRE): telemetry costs: don't emit per-request counters for every preview. Use pre-aggregated histograms keyed by (org, route, model_variant) computed by infra pipeline. Only allow higher-res windows during the temporary sample boost.
Keiko (Eng): debate: compute-on-save (fast, cached) vs compute-on-open (real-time). Proposal: compute-on-save with stored estimate + last_refreshed timestamp; compute-on-open can optionally trigger an async refresh if stale > threshold. Provide a "refresh estimates" button.
Annie (PM): UX copy: if stale show small note "Estimates based on sampling from last 24h; actual costs may vary. Click to refresh (may take ~1-2 min)."
Raj (Console): also add an admin banner if the org has hit estimate-sampling budget to explain why preview isn't available.
Keiko (Eng): persistence: store just the aggregated vector (no raw traces) and a small metadata blob: {sample_rate_used, window_seconds, ttl_seconds}. TTL maybe 7 days.
Nina (SRE): rate-limits: backend should enforce per-org QPS for estimate generation and per-cluster worker concurrency limits. We'll set conservative defaults and allow infra overrides.
preview-bot: Estimate job queued for org:acme-corp, view_id:fv-23 -> job_id:est-98765
Keiko (Eng): other APIs: add a query param `?include_quota_impact=true` that returns monthlyized cost at current traffic levels and delta vs present quota. requires an org traffic estimate.
Annie (PM): sticky ask: include a small chart showing "estimated monthly burn" vs current committed quota and a CTA to request quota bump with prefilled numbers. That will help sales & CS.
Nina (SRE): final ops note: ensure feature respects org telemetry opt-out. If an org has disabled per-route telemetry we should fall back to synthetic estimates (model-level averages) and mark confidence low.
Raj (Console): I'll sketch mocks and attach CSV sample to the PR. We'll also add an a11y check for the confidence ring.
Keiko (Eng): I'll open the backend RFC and include pseudocode for sampling/reservoir logic and a small cost model fn.
Annie (PM): thanks all  I'll track the MAE & preview-usage metrics in the rollout doc. drop PR links here when ready.
preview-bot: Job est-98765 finished: succeeded, samples_used: 1534, note: confidence=81%
Keiko (Eng): PRs: console #2418 (mock + CSV), backend #3420 (estimates API + worker). tagging infra & billing for review.
